entries: **Windows crashed on startup in v0.29.34 through v0.29.36.** The 0.29.34 refactor moved `wintray.py` to `wintray/app.py` and `tui.py` to `tui/app.py`, but `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still hidden-imported the old top-level module names. Both packages' `__init__.py` are empty, so PyInstaller packaged only empty shells and dropped the whole `wintray` dependency tree (`panels.*`, `updates.*`, and more) along with it — every downloader hit `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wintray.app'`, and the TUI fallback failed the same way since `tui.app` was missing too. macOS was unaffected; `setup_app.py` collects the whole package by name via py2app, and the names still matched after the rename.

**The Windows build script now verifies the packaged exe actually contains `wintray.app` and `tui.app`.** It previously only checked that an exe file existed, which is why the three broken releases above shipped without anyone noticing — the file was there, just missing the modules users needed. `build_windows.ps1` now reads the PyInstaller archive contents with `archive_viewer` and throws if either entry-point module is missing, so a future regression fails the release job instead of shipping a broken artifact.

entries: **Antigravity quota now raises notifications, the way Claude Code and Codex already did.** The `agy_session` and `agy_weekly` channels were missing from the notification allow-list, so the two Antigravity rows could run to the floor without ever saying so. Antigravity quota is the one source that comes from a network endpoint behind a local cache rather than a file on disk, so `QuotaRowState.available` is hard-coded to `True`; a stale snapshot now passes `available=False` instead, so an expired cache can no longer announce that the quota has run out.

**The Antigravity rows now warn before the quota is gone, not after.** They had never been wired to the burn-rate forecast, so their `warning` flag was permanently `False` — Claude and Codex warned ahead of a reset and Antigravity stayed silent until it hit the floor. Both rows now register their own tracker. Samples are timestamped with the snapshot's own `fetched_at` rather than the wall clock, because the Antigravity snapshot only changes every five minutes and polling would otherwise read the same payload again and invent a slope out of it. Both rows use a 3600-second window: at one sample per five minutes the default ten-minute window never collects `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`, which is the same as not forecasting at all. A stale snapshot suppresses the forecast entirely, matching what `agy_window_keeper` already does.

**`usage doctor` now catches a Codex history migration that would silently zero the token counts.** Codex has begun writing tables such as `rollout_migration_state`, and if that migration lands and the `.jsonl` files stop being written, `loaders/codex_loader.py` returns zero without an error anywhere. The check warns when the session `.jsonl` files hold no entry from the last seven days while `thread_history_1.sqlite` does hold `thread_turns` from that window.

**`usage doctor` now reconciles its own Claude cost against the official one.** It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` from `usage-status.json` with the figure usage calculates itself and warns when they differ by more than 20% and more than $1. On the machine this was written on they differed by 46.4%, because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate — exactly the kind of drift the offline fallback table is known to hide.

**The project usage card no longer clips its rows on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels.** A panel measures its own natural height by releasing the whole `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Both panels write their project card as `flex: 1`, which means a flex basis of zero, and the card's own `overflow: hidden` — the retro window chrome depends on it — suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would otherwise hold the card open. The card therefore collapsed to its title bar during the measurement, and the reported height was short by exactly the project rows: 877 pixels for WIN95 and 876 for Newspaper against 923 for the structurally identical Classic. The measurement now pins such stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` while it measures and restores them afterwards, so no panel's visual design changes.

**Eight more modules moved out of the repository root.** `quota/` took `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper`; `usage_common/` took `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper`. The shared-utility package is named `usage_common` rather than `common` because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into a shared `site-packages`, where `common` is about the most collision-prone name available. No compatibility shims were left behind — every import in the repository was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped the eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed. Behavior is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 的專案用量卡不再截掉資料列

body.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 面板上的專案用量卡，現在不會只露出標題列，把底下資料列截掉。面板量自然高度時會暫時把整條 `height: 100%` 改成 `auto`。但兩個面板都把專案卡寫成 `flex: 1`，其彈性基準是零；卡片自己的 `overflow: hidden` 是復古視窗外框所需，卻壓掉可撐開內容的自動最小尺寸。量測時，卡片因此縮成標題列，WIN95 報出 877 像素、Newspaper 報出 876 像素，而結構相同的 Classic 是 923 像素。⟦像量布料時先把被拉緊的橡皮筋鬆開，才不會把整件衣服量短。⟧ 現在量測會暫時把這類可拉伸子項固定為 `flex: 0 0 auto`，量完再還原，因此面板的視覺設計不會改變。
body.en: Project usage cards on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels no longer show only their title bar while clipping the rows below. To measure natural height, a panel temporarily releases the `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Yet both panels write the project card as `flex: 1`, whose flex basis is zero, while the card's `overflow: hidden`, needed by retro window chrome, suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would keep it open. During measurement the card therefore collapsed to its title bar: WIN95 reported 877 pixels and Newspaper 876, versus 923 for structurally identical Classic. ⟦It is like loosening a stretched elastic before measuring cloth, so the whole garment is not measured too short.⟧ Measurement now temporarily pins stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` and restores them afterward, leaving each panel's visual design unchanged.

entries: **Migration is the fourteenth visual theme.** Its dusk sky carries a latitude-and-longitude grid while three V-shaped flocks cross at different speeds, their wings moving as route labels such as `ROUTE. 7` identify the journeys. It follows the Lepidoptera panel's illustrated field-guide approach.

**The README theme galleries are rebuilt from synthetic data and now line up.** All five READMEs listed ten screenshots under a heading that said thirteen — `stained_glass` and `origami` had never been photographed, `catppuccin` only in Chinese. The old images were also hand-captured from a real machine, so they carried actual project names and dollar amounts onto a public page, and predated the Antigravity card entirely. Every shot is now regenerated by `scripts/make_panel_shots.py` from the same synthetic payload the website uses. The galleries place three images per row, so a panel that is shorter than its neighbours pushes the whole grid out of line; the shots are therefore all captured at the tallest panel's height, and `world_cup` — a wide HUD that is genuinely 243 pixels shorter than the rest — sits this gallery out. Twelve images, four even rows. All thirteen are still on the website, where each one is shown alone at its own size. GitHub strips scripts and iframes from Markdown, so the README stays static images.

**The website now shows all thirteen panels, live, instead of ten screenshots.** The gallery held ten static images; `origami` and `stained_glass` had never been photographed at all, and `catppuccin` only in Chinese — so the page showed ten themes under a heading that said thirteen. It now renders the real panel HTML in a frame with a hand-written demo payload, and the theme list comes from `panels.all_panels()`, so a fourteenth panel appears on the site by running `scripts/make_panel_demo.py` rather than by remembering to take two more screenshots. Picking a language on the site switches the panel too, in all five languages, because the site's existing `applyLang()` forwards to it. The panel is display-only — its Switch Panel and Quit buttons have no native side to answer them on a web page. The old screenshots stay in `docs/`; the READMEs still link to them.

**Stained Glass now turns like a kaleidoscope.** The existing `sunlightSweep` remains, while layered fragments counter-rotate through `kaleidoscopeTurn` and the light sweep follows through `kaleidoscopeSweep`; its id and name stay the same, so this is a visual upgrade to the existing panel rather than a new theme.

**Seven more modules moved out of the repository root.** `panel_window` and `panel_window_state` joined `panels/`, `critter_frames` joined `menubar/`, and a new `installer/` package took `setup_hook`, `session_hooks`, `statusline_settings`, and `login_item` — the four modules that install usage into the user's system. The root is down to 28 Python files. The package is named `installer` rather than `setup` because the repository root is on `sys.path` and a top-level `setup` package would shadow the bare `import setup` that setuptools and py2app perform during a build — a failure that only surfaces when packaging, never in the test suite. The four modules that resolve the hook scripts by walking up from `__file__` now walk up one extra level, since those scripts stay at the root to run under the system Python.

title.zh-TW: README 主題圖集重拍，補齊缺圖也遮住真實資料
title.en: README galleries are rebuilt to complete missing themes and hide real data

body.zh-TW: 五份 README（專案說明頁）原本像五張用不同資料填寫的練習卷：照片少了主題又高低不齊，舊圖還是從真實機器手動截圖，讓真實專案名稱和金額帶到公開頁面。⟦五份練習卷皆用同份範例資料重印，版面齊，資料不外洩。⟧標題說有十三張，卻只有十張截圖；`stained_glass` 與 `origami` 沒拍過，`catppuccin` 只有中文版，Antigravity 卡也比舊圖晚出現。現在 `scripts/make_panel_shots.py` 以網站同一份合成展示資料重建截圖。圖集每列三張，較矮面板會把整列推歪，所以才統一按最高面板高度拍攝；比其他面板矮 243 像素的寬型畫面資訊層 `world_cup` 不放進圖集，留下十二張、四列對齊。網站仍各自以原本尺寸呈現十三張。GitHub 會移除 Markdown 裡的腳本與 iframe，所以 README 保留靜態圖片。
body.en: Five READMEs were like practice sheets filled with different sample data: photos missed themes, failed to line up, and old images were hand-captured from a real machine, carrying real project names and dollar amounts onto public pages. ⟦It is like reprinting five practice sheets with one set of sample data: layouts line up without printing real project names and dollar amounts in public version.⟧Headings claimed thirteen images but showed ten: `stained_glass` and `origami` had never been photographed, `catppuccin` only in Chinese, and old images predated Antigravity card. `scripts/make_panel_shots.py` now rebuilds shots from same synthetic payload used by website. Since galleries put three pictures in each row, a shorter panel pushes whole grid out of line, so all shots use tallest panel height; wide HUD `world_cup`, genuinely 243 pixels shorter, stays out. That leaves twelve images in four even rows. Website still displays all thirteen alone at own size. GitHub strips scripts and iframes from Markdown, so README remains static images.

items.original: **The README theme galleries are rebuilt from synthetic data and now line up.** All five READMEs listed ten screenshots under a heading that said thirteen — `stained_glass` and `origami` had never been photographed, `catppuccin` only in Chinese. The old images were also hand-captured from a real machine, so they carried actual project names and dollar amounts onto a public page, and predated the Antigravity card entirely. Every shot is now regenerated by `scripts/make_panel_shots.py` from the same synthetic payload the website uses. The galleries place three images per row, so a panel that is shorter than its neighbours pushes the whole grid out of line; the shots are therefore all captured at the tallest panel's height, and `world_cup` — a wide HUD that is genuinely 243 pixels shorter than the rest — sits this gallery out. Twelve images, four even rows. All thirteen are still on the website, where each one is shown alone at its own size. GitHub strips scripts and iframes from Markdown, so the README stays static images.

title.zh-TW: 網站圖集改播十三個活面板，語言也會跟著切換
title.en: Website gallery runs all thirteen live panels and switches their language

body.zh-TW: 網站上的主題牆從十張靜態截圖，改成能直接看的十三個真實面板。⟦這像車站的即時看板：能看見列車實際狀態，但在看板上按按鈕不會讓列車轉軌。⟧原先 `origami`、`stained_glass` 沒有圖，`catppuccin` 只顯示中文，於是「十三個主題」實際只看到十個。現在網站把面板網頁原碼放進框架，餵入手寫的展示資料；主題清單從 `panels.all_panels()` 取得。新增第十四個時，執行 `scripts/make_panel_demo.py` 即會出現在網站，不必再記得補拍兩張圖。網站選語言時，既有 `applyLang()` 也會把切換交給面板，因此五種語言都會一起變。面板只供展示，網頁沒有原生端能回應 Switch Panel 與 Quit 按鈕。舊截圖留在 `docs/`，README 仍連到它們。
body.en: Theme wall on website moves from ten static screenshots to thirteen real panels you can view directly. ⟦It is like station's live departure board: you can see actual train status, but pressing its buttons will not make train switch tracks.⟧`origami` and `stained_glass` had no image, while `catppuccin` showed only Chinese, so thirteen themes meant ten visible themes. Website now puts real panel HTML into frame with hand-written demo payload, and gets theme list from `panels.all_panels()`. When fourteenth panel arrives, running `scripts/make_panel_demo.py` places it on site without remembering two more photos. Existing `applyLang()` also passes site language choice to panel, so all five languages change together. Panel is display-only: no native side on web page can answer Switch Panel or Quit buttons. Old screenshots remain in `docs/`, and READMEs still link to them.

items.original: **The website now shows all thirteen panels, live, instead of ten screenshots.** The gallery held ten static images; `origami` and `stained_glass` had never been photographed at all, and `catppuccin` only in Chinese — so the page showed ten themes under a heading that said thirteen. It now renders the real panel HTML in a frame with a hand-written demo payload, and the theme list comes from `panels.all_panels()`, so a fourteenth panel appears on the site by running `scripts/make_panel_demo.py` rather than by remembering to take two more screenshots. Picking a language on the site switches the panel too, in all five languages, because the site's existing `applyLang()` forwards to it. The panel is display-only — its Switch Panel and Quit buttons have no native side to answer them on a web page. The old screenshots stay in `docs/`; the READMEs still link to them.

title.zh-TW: Stained Glass 加入萬花筒般的反向旋轉
title.en: Stained Glass gains counter-rotation like a kaleidoscope

body.zh-TW: Stained Glass 面板原本的光線掃過效果還在，畫面卻開始多了一層轉動。⟦轉動萬花筒時，玻璃碎片會朝相反方向繞行，光也會跟著折射的節奏移動；這次的更新正是在面板裡補上那個變化。⟧分層碎片由 `kaleidoscopeTurn` 反向旋轉，光線掃過則由 `kaleidoscopeSweep` 接著走。原有的 `sunlightSweep` 保留，面板的識別碼和名稱也不變，所以這是既有 Stained Glass 的視覺升級，不是另一個新主題。
body.en: Stained Glass keeps its existing light sweep, but scene now gains another layer of motion. ⟦When kaleidoscope turns, glass fragments circle in opposite directions and light follows rhythm of refraction; update adds that change to panel.⟧Layered fragments counter-rotate through `kaleidoscopeTurn`, while light sweep follows through `kaleidoscopeSweep`. Existing `sunlightSweep` remains, as do panel's id and name, so this upgrades existing Stained Glass visually rather than creating another theme.

items.original: **Stained Glass now turns like a kaleidoscope.** The existing `sunlightSweep` remains, while layered fragments counter-rotate through `kaleidoscopeTurn` and the light sweep follows through `kaleidoscopeSweep`; its id and name stay the same, so this is a visual upgrade to the existing panel rather than a new theme.

title.zh-TW: 七個模組搬進分區，打包時避開 `setup` 撞名
title.en: Seven modules move into packages to avoid a `setup` naming collision at build time

body.zh-TW: 根目錄少七模組，剩 28 個 Python 檔。⟦拍片前分工：窗戶交場景組、選單列交道具組，安裝交後勤組。⟧`panel_window`、`panel_window_state`→`panels/`，`critter_frames`→`menubar/`；`setup_hook`、`session_hooks`、`statusline_settings`、`login_item` 四模組將 usage 安裝到使用者系統，移入新 `installer/`。`installer/` 不叫 `setup`：根目錄列入 `sys.path`（找模組清單），同名頂層套件會遮住 setuptools、py2app 打包的 `import setup`。僅打包出錯，測試不會發現。四模組循 `__file__` 往上找掛鉤腳本；腳本留根目錄由系統 Python 執行，故多找一層。
body.en: Project root moves out seven more modules and now holds only 28 Python files. ⟦It is like assigning film crew before a shoot: window work goes to set team, menu-bar work to props team, and installation work to logistics team.⟧`panel_window` and `panel_window_state` join `panels/`; `critter_frames` joins `menubar/`; four modules `setup_hook`, `session_hooks`, `statusline_settings`, and `login_item` install usage into user's system and join new `installer/` package. It cannot be called `setup`: repository root sits on Python's `sys.path` (list of places Python searches for modules), and a top-level package of that name would shadow `import setup` used by setuptools and py2app during packaging. Failure surfaces only when packaging, not in test suite. Four modules used to walk upward from `__file__` for hook scripts; scripts remain at root to run under system Python, so they now walk up one extra level.

items.original: **Seven more modules moved out of the repository root.** `panel_window` and `panel_window_state` joined `panels/`, `critter_frames` joined `menubar/`, and a new `installer/` package took `setup_hook`, `session_hooks`, `statusline_settings`, and `login_item` — the four modules that install usage into the user's system. The root is down to 28 Python files. The package is named `installer` rather than `setup` because the repository root is on `sys.path` and a top-level `setup` package would shadow the bare `import setup` that setuptools and py2app perform during a build — a failure that only surfaces when packaging, never in the test suite. The four modules that resolve the hook scripts by walking up from `__file__` now walk up one extra level, since those scripts stay at the root to run under the system Python.

entries: **The menu bar percentages are now bold.** They were drawn at the menu bar's own point size in regular weight, which left them lighter than everything around them — hard to read at a glance over a light wallpaper. Same size, bold weight; the strip grows by about 5 points.

**The provider marks in the menu bar are now monochrome and follow the menu bar's own appearance.** The color art had to work against whatever wallpaper was behind it, and the Codex mark in particular collapsed into an indistinct blob at menu bar size because its detail came from color rather than shape. The marks are now template images — the system tints them black on a light menu bar and white on a dark one, so they stay legible everywhere, and they match the critters, which have always been drawn this way. They are also 14 to 16 points now.

**The 77 modules that sat loose in the repository root are now grouped into packages.** `menubar/`, `loaders/`, `wintray/`, `discussion/`, `tui/`, and `updates/` absorbed 42 of them; the root is down to 35. Nothing moved that runs outside the virtualenv — the status line hooks are still plain files at the top level, because `usage setup` copies them into the user's home directory to run under the system Python. Behavior is unchanged; only import paths moved.

**A test now guards the modules that `main.py` loads by name.** Those loads are plain strings, so no search finds them and a moved module leaves the string pointing at nothing while the whole suite still passes and the app fails to launch. The test reads `main.py` and checks every attribute it calls on such a module against that module's actual contents.

title.zh-TW: 選單列數字與供應商標記更容易辨認
title.en: Menu bar numbers and provider marks are easier to read

body.en: ⟦Think of the menu bar as a sign against changing wall colors: both letters and marks need weight and shape, not color alone, to stay readable.⟧Percentages keep their point size but are now bold, making the strip about 5 points taller and easier to read over light wallpaper. Provider marks, the small images that identify a service, are now monochrome template images. They turn black on a light menu bar and white on a dark one. Shape now does the work that color detail once did, so the Codex mark does not collapse into a blur at menu-bar size; the marks also match the critters, which have always been drawn this way. They are now 14 to 16 points tall.

title.zh-TW: 程式搬進分區後，也逐項核對啟動清單
title.en: Moved modules now come with a launch-list check

body.zh-TW: ⟦整理倉庫，搬盒子進分區後仍得核對出貨清單與新架位，否則開門後才發現找不到貨。⟧散在 repository root 的 77 個模組，歸進 packages（套件，程式的可匯入資料夾）。`menubar/`、`loaders/`、`wintray/`、`discussion/`、`tui/`、`updates/` 六個資料夾收進 42 個，root 剩 35 個。這只改 import paths（匯入路徑，程式尋找其他程式碼的位置）。行為不變。虛擬環境外的檔案沒搬；狀態列 hooks（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）仍留頂層，因為 `usage setup` 會複製到家目錄，由系統 Python 執行。`main.py` 以字串載入模組，搜尋找不到；搬走後，字串可能指向空處，測試仍通過，App 卻無法啟動。新增測試讀取 `main.py`，比對呼叫的模組屬性與內容。
body.en: ⟦Tidying a warehouse takes more than moving boxes from the doorway into sections: the shipping list must also be checked against each new shelf, or opening day reveals missing stock.⟧The 77 modules that had been loose in the repository root are now grouped into packages, folders that hold related importable code. `menubar/`, `loaders/`, `wintray/`, `discussion/`, `tui/`, and `updates/` absorbed 42 of them, leaving 35 at the root. Only import paths, where code looks for other code, changed; behavior did not. Files that run outside the virtualenv stayed put: status-line hooks, files called at particular moments, remain at the top level because `usage setup` copies them to the user's home directory for the system Python. `main.py` names modules with plain strings, which search cannot find. A moved module could leave one pointing nowhere, while the test suite still passes and the app fails to launch. A new test reads `main.py` and checks every module attribute it calls against that module's contents.

entries: **The Claude Code status line is now verified on Linux.** The hook is stdlib-only and `usage setup` never gated the Claude path on macOS or Windows, so it already worked there — nothing tested it, so it went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` on Ubuntu and feeds it a real statusLine payload.

**`uvx usage-cli` runs the terminal interface without installing anything.** The CLI is now published to PyPI as `usage-cli`, so Linux and Windows users can try `usage status --json`, the dashboard, and the reports without downloading the macOS app; uv prepares Python 3.13 on its own. `uv tool install usage-cli` keeps the command around as `usage`. The distribution name is `usage-cli` because `usage` was already taken on PyPI in 2016; both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands. This path ships the CLI only — the menu bar and system tray apps are unchanged and still come from the release downloads.

**Antigravity (agy) usage is now attributed to the project you were actually working in.** Every agy entry previously recorded a fixed `"Antigravity"` project name, so the project usage ranking couldn't show which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the session's recorded shell commands, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when none is found.

title.zh-TW: Linux 支援狀態列驗證，標準函式庫掛鉤正式納入測試
title.en: Claude Code status line is verified on Linux with real test payloads

body.zh-TW: 想在 Linux 環境藉由 usage 掌握 Claude Code 的用量與狀態，過去常因文件未提及而不敢確定是否支援。事實上，負責串接的 hook（事件發生時觸發的自動處理程式）僅依賴 Python 標準函式庫，且 `usage setup` 在 macOS 與 Windows 上從未設下系統限制，在 Linux 本就能正常運作；過去只是缺少自動化測試驗證，才一直未寫入官方文件。現在 CI 會在 Ubuntu 系統中建立拋棄式 `HOME` 目錄安裝掛鉤，並傳入真實的 statusLine（終端機底部的即時狀態列）酬載進行驗證。⟦這好比一件出廠就具備防水機能的風衣，過去因說明書未印認證標章讓人不敢在雨天穿出門；直到品管中心在標準測試台噴灑真實水柱，確認它確實防水。⟧
body.en: Linux users looking to track Claude Code usage and metrics through usage previously had to guess whether the integration was supported because it was missing from documentation. In reality, the integration hook relies entirely on the Python standard library, and `usage setup` never placed an operating system check on the Claude path for macOS or Windows, meaning it already functioned on Linux without issue. It simply lacked test coverage and went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` directory on Ubuntu and feeds it a genuine statusLine payload to verify behavior. ⟦It is like a jacket manufactured with waterproof fabric that lacked a certified badge in the user manual, leaving customers hesitant to wear it in the rain until the quality-control lab blasted it with actual water jets on a test rig and verified that it was waterproof.⟧

CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` on Ubuntu and feeds it a real statusLine payload.

title.zh-TW: 依工作目錄精準歸帳，Antigravity 用量不再全數掛在單一專案
title.en: Antigravity usage is attributed to actual project directories instead of a static label

body.zh-TW: ⟦像公務採購報帳時，若所有發票都一律蓋上總公司大印，月底的部門支出排行便完全看不出各專案到底花了多少經費；唯有依據出差工單上的工作地點逐筆歸帳，才能精準呈現各專案的真實花費。⟧ Antigravity（agy）的用量現在會準確歸屬至你實際作業的專案中。過去每筆 agy 記錄都固定寫入 `"Antigravity"` 專案名稱，導致專案用量排行無法看出 token（AI 計費的文字單位）到底花在哪個資料夾。現在記錄會從各工作階段所執行的 shell 指令中自動解析工作目錄，只有在找不到任何指令紀錄時，才會以備援方式退回使用 `"Antigravity"` 名稱。
body.en: ⟦It is like expense reimbursement at a company where stamping every invoice with a generic corporate seal leaves department expense rankings unable to show how much each project spent, until invoices are attributed to the exact work site from travel logs to reflect accurate project costs.⟧ Antigravity (agy) token consumption is now accurately attributed to the project you were actually working in. Previously, every agy entry recorded a static `"Antigravity"` project name, which prevented the project usage ranking from showing which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the recorded shell commands in each session, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when no command is found.

entries: **The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire shared file.** An exported HTML report previously still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, so masking hid the names on screen without removing them from the file. The unmasked copy is now dropped from the export. If you shared a masked report from an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.

**The donut legend and project-naming insights are covered by the mask as well.** Both previously kept showing real project names; insights now read `Project N`, matching the numbering already used by the project table.

**Local files are created with owner-only permissions.** Attachments, exported reports and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/` and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were created with permissions that allowed other local accounts on the same machine to read them. New files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Attachment import no longer copies the source file's permissions along with the file.
**The quarantine directory is created with an explicit mode.** Files moved into it already kept owner-only permissions; the directory itself did not.

**An oversized line in a JSONL history file no longer exhausts memory.** Lines are read against a 64 MiB ceiling, set from a measured 23 MB real-world maximum, and skipped cleanly when they exceed it. Deeply nested JSON that raises `RecursionError` is treated as an invalid line.

title.zh-TW: 遮蔽專案名稱全面生效，圖表與匯出檔案不洩密
title.en: Masking project names covers the full exported file, charts, and insights

body.zh-TW: 「遮蔽專案名稱」現在會套用至整份匯出 usage 報表，分享時不再只是把名稱藏在畫面上。過去匯出的 HTML 報表雖然在畫面上隱藏了專案名稱，檔案內部卻仍夾帶未遮蔽的資料集，等於只在螢幕遮住卻沒從檔案拿掉；現在未遮蔽的副本已自匯出檔完全移除。過去圓餅圖圖例與專案名稱深入分析都仍顯示真實專案名稱；現在兩者也一併納入遮蔽，分析文字改為 `Project N`，對齊專案表格既有的編號。⟦這像拿黑筆塗黑公文上的機密名稱，以前只塗了複寫紙表面、底層仍夾著原稿；現在則在寄出前把原始底稿徹底抽除。⟧若你曾分享過舊版產生的遮蔽報表，請將那些檔案視為未遮蔽處理。
body.en: The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire exported usage report, rather than merely hiding names on screen when you share it. Previously, an exported HTML report still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, hiding project names on screen without actually removing them from the file; that unmasked copy is now completely dropped from exports. Previously, both the donut legend and project-naming insights still showed real project names; both are now covered by the mask, with insights displaying `Project N` to match the numbering in the project table. ⟦It is like redacting confidential names on a document: earlier releases only blacked out the top carbon copy while leaving the original underneath, but the source sheet is now completely removed before delivery.⟧ If you shared a masked report generated by an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.

items.original:
**The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire shared file.** An exported HTML report previously still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, so masking hid the names on screen without removing them from the file. The unmasked copy is now dropped from the export. If you shared a masked report from an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.
**The donut legend and project-naming insights are covered by the mask as well.** Both previously kept showing real project names; insights now read `Project N`, matching the numbering already used by the project table.

title.zh-TW: 本機檔案限擁有者，隔離目錄明確設定存取模式
title.en: Local files are owner-only; the quarantine directory gets an explicit access mode

body.zh-TW: ⟦在共用辦公室存放私人物品，不只要把置物箱上鎖，放箱子的儲藏室大門也得加鎖，同棟樓的其他帳號才翻看不到內容。⟧ usage 現在為本機建立的檔案與目錄全面套用僅限擁有者的存取權限。以往存放在 `~/.usage/`、`~/.usage-reports/` 與 `~/Library/Logs/usage/` 底下的附件、匯出報表與紀錄檔，權限曾允許同部電腦的其他本機帳號讀取；現在新建立的檔案權限一律設為 `0600`，所屬目錄則設為 `0700`。匯入附件時也不再複製來源檔案原有的權限。此外，過去移入隔離目錄的檔案雖保有擁有者權限，但目錄本身並未限制；現在該隔離目錄在建立時也會設定明確的存取模式。
body.en: ⟦When storing personal items in a shared building, locking individual storage bins is not enough; the storage room door itself must be secured so other tenants in the building cannot browse the contents.⟧ usage now creates local files and directories with owner-only access permissions. Attachments, exported reports, and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/`, and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were previously created with permissions that let other local accounts on the same machine read them; new files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Importing attachments also stops copying the source file's existing permissions. Additionally, while files moved into the quarantine directory already kept owner-only permissions, the quarantine directory itself now receives an explicit access mode upon creation.

items.original:
**Local files are created with owner-only permissions.** Attachments, exported reports and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/` and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were created with permissions that allowed other local accounts on the same machine to read them. New files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Attachment import no longer copies the source file's permissions along with the file.
**The quarantine directory is created with an explicit mode.** Files moved into it already kept owner-only permissions; the directory itself did not.

title.zh-TW: 超長行設上限，深層巢狀改列無效行
title.en: Oversized JSONL lines are capped; deep nesting is treated as invalid

body.zh-TW: JSONL（每行各放一筆 JSON 資料的檔案格式）歷史檔案中的異常大行，不再會耗盡記憶體、拖垮整個讀取流程。usage 現在以 64 MiB 為上限來讀取每行資料，這個數值是根據實測真實環境中 23 MB 的最大記錄所設定；一旦單行資料超過此上限，程式會直接略過它並繼續運作。遇到層層巢狀過深而引發遞迴錯誤（`RecursionError`）的 JSON 內容，也會直接當成無效行處理。⟦這像包裹分揀線入口設了兩道檢查：尺寸過大的貨物，以及包裝層數深到難以檢查的貨物，都直接撥到旁道，讓其他包裹繼續前進。⟧這能防止超過 64 MiB 或因巢狀過深引發 RecursionError 的歷史資料中斷讀取流程。
body.en: An oversized line in a JSONL (a file format with one JSON record per line) history file will no longer exhaust memory or derail reading. Lines are now read against a 64 MiB ceiling, which was set from a measured real-world maximum of 23 MB; whenever a line exceeds this threshold, it is skipped so processing can continue. Deeply nested JSON structures that raise a recursion error (`RecursionError`) are likewise treated as invalid lines. ⟦It is like a parcel sorting line with two screening checks: items that are too large or wrapped in layers too deep to inspect are sent directly down a side lane, while the rest keeps moving.⟧ This ensures history files containing oversized lines or deeply nested JSON that raises RecursionError cannot derail your usage history.

items.original: **An oversized line in a JSONL history file no longer exhausts memory.** Lines are read against a 64 MiB ceiling, set from a measured 23 MB real-world maximum, and skipped cleanly when they exceed it. Deeply nested JSON that raises `RecursionError` is treated as an invalid line.

entries: **`usage status` no longer prints floating-point noise in percentages.** Session and weekly percentages were interpolated straight into the string, so a value like 42.30000000000001 could appear instead of 42.3. Both are now formatted to one decimal place.

**The Windows tray tooltip shows the same numbers as the panel, and no longer omits Antigravity.** It displayed *remaining* percent (100 minus used) while every panel shows *used* percent; the tooltip now matches, and adds its own Antigravity line when that card isn't hidden. The Claude line was also reformatted to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

**Windows update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** The GitHub Release body's `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` markers rendered literally in the update dialog; macOS fixed this in 0.29.28 but the fix never reached Windows. Both platforms now share the same formatter.

**The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).
**The website's theme count was corrected from 12 to 13** — Catppuccin, shipped in 0.29.23, wasn't being counted — across all five languages.

**The social preview image reflects Windows support and reuses the site's own visuals.** It used to say "macOS Menu Bar App"; the new 1200×630 image pairs the brand and title with an actual panel screenshot (Claude, Codex, Antigravity) in the site's own colors, and dropped from 573KB to 96KB.
**README status-line screenshots are now recorded animations**, one per language instead of borrowed from English, made legible at README width.

**Status-line setup is now its own README section** instead of a subsection buried under Windows Support, so macOS users don't skip it, with terminology filled in for both platforms and Traditional Chinese.

title.zh-TW: usage status 消除百分比雜訊，統一保留一位小數
title.en: usage status removes floating-point noise from percentage outputs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行 `usage status` 查詢額度時，工作階段（session，單次使用的時間區段）與每週百分比數值不再出現多餘的小數雜訊。過去程式將數值直接拼進字串，導致畫面上可能出現如 42.30000000000001 這類冗長的小數。⟦這就像電子磅秤把原本因感應過敏而跳出的一長串零碎小數抹平，在螢幕上整齊收攏到小數點後一位。⟧現在這兩項百分比都統一格式化為一位小數（例如 42.3），讓輸出的資訊乾淨俐落。
body.en: Running `usage status` to inspect your quotas will no longer spit out messy floating-point noise in session and weekly percentages. The tool previously interpolated raw numerical values directly into output strings, producing cluttered readouts like 42.30000000000001 instead of a clean 42.3. ⟦It is like a digital scale rounding off jittery multi-digit fractions to show a single steady decimal on its display.⟧ Both session and weekly metrics are now strictly formatted to one decimal place, keeping terminal output predictable and tidy.

items.original: **`usage status` no longer prints floating-point noise in percentages.** Session and weekly percentages were interpolated straight into the string, so a value like 42.30000000000001 could appear instead of 42.3. Both are now formatted to one decimal place.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示對齊面板數值，納入 Antigravity
title.en: Windows tray tooltip aligns with panel values and includes Antigravity

body.zh-TW: 把游標移到 Windows 系統匣（tray，工作列右側的常駐圖示區）圖示上方時，浮動提示文字顯示的數值現在與面板完全一致，而且不再漏掉 Antigravity。過去提示文字顯示的是「剩餘」百分比（以 100 減去已用量），而各個面板顯示的都是「已使用」百分比，兩邊數字對不起來。⟦這如同把公告欄的各項用量改用同一個已使用標準，補上漏列的 Antigravity，並把 Claude 條目整理成和其餘項目相同的一行格式。⟧現在提示文字統一改為已使用百分比，並在 Antigravity 卡片未隱藏時補上專屬一行；Claude 的顯示行也同步重構為與 Codex 和 Antigravity 一致的單行「工作階段 · 每週」排版。
body.en: Hovering over the Windows system tray icon now reveals tooltip figures that perfectly match what you see inside the main panel, while no longer skipping Antigravity. The tooltip previously showed the *remaining* percentage (calculated as 100 minus used) while every panel displays the *used* percentage, creating unnecessary confusion. ⟦It is like giving every line on a noticeboard one used-amount standard, restoring the missing Antigravity line, and setting the Claude entry in the same one-line format as the rest.⟧ The tooltip now reports used percentages across the board, adds an Antigravity row whenever that card is visible, and reformats the Claude entry to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip shows the same numbers as the panel, and no longer omits Antigravity.** It displayed *remaining* percent (100 minus used) while every panel shows *used* percent; the tooltip now matches, and adds its own Antigravity line when that card isn't hidden. The Claude line was also reformatted to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

title.zh-TW: Windows 更新通知去除原始 Markdown 標記
title.en: Windows update notifications strip raw Markdown markers

body.zh-TW: 當 Windows 跳出新版本更新通知時，說明視窗不再直接印出未解析的 Markdown（以特殊符號標示粗體或標題的排版語法）原始標記。先前來自 GitHub Release 內文的 `##` 標題、`**` 粗體與 `` ` `` 程式碼符號，在更新對話框中都會被原樣渲染出來。這項問題在 macOS 平台已於 0.29.28 版解決，但修復一直未同步至 Windows 平台；現在兩個系統已共用同一套格式化處理器。⟦這好比印刷廠在樣品書送達各分店前先將排版標記擦拭乾淨，讓讀者看見精緻排版而非編輯痕跡。⟧
body.en: Update dialogs on Windows will no longer greet you with unformatted Markdown markup when a new version drops. Release descriptions pulled from GitHub previously rendered literal `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` tokens directly inside the notification window. While macOS resolved this display glitch in version 0.29.28, the corresponding fix had not made its way to Windows until now. Both platforms now route release text through the shared formatter. ⟦It is like a printing press stripping proofreading marks before handing books to readers across every branch store.⟧

items.original: **Windows update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** The GitHub Release body's `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` markers rendered literally in the update dialog; macOS fixed this in 0.29.28 but the fix never reached Windows. Both platforms now share the same formatter.

title.zh-TW: 官網修復行動版導覽與分享錨點
title.en: Website fixes mobile navigation and shareable anchors

body.zh-TW: 用手機瀏覽 usage 官方網站時，窄螢幕不會再失去導覽方向。在螢幕寬度低於 640px 時，原本整條消失的導覽列現在改由標示 Sections 的展開選單替代。⟦好比登山步道的窄入口設有可展開路線牌，改走其他語言路線時，原本標記的位置仍保留下來。⟧切換語言也不再把 `#install` 等分享錨點改寫為 `#<lang>`，因此在切換前複製的連結仍能開啟原先位置。
body.en: On the public website, a narrow mobile screen will no longer leave you without a way to navigate. Below 640px, the navigation bar that previously disappeared entirely is replaced by a labeled, expandable Sections menu. ⟦It is like a narrow trailhead gaining an expandable route board that keeps your marked location when you switch to another language route.⟧ Switching languages also no longer rewrites shared anchors such as `#install` to `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch still open at their original location.

items.original: **The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).

title.zh-TW: 官網補強頁尾可讀性、圖片載入與點擊操作
title.en: Website improves footer readability, image loading, and tap targets

body.zh-TW: 網站在手機上顯示時，容易被忽略的可讀性與操作細節也一併補齊。頁尾文字現在符合 AA 級對比要求，前景與背景的差異足以辨識；圖片改為需要顯示時才讀取。⟦這像候車資訊換成人人看得清楚的字，月台畫面接近時才亮起，按鈕與連結的可點擊區域也留出足夠空間。⟧各個點擊目標至少為 24px，行動版主導覽則為 44px，手指操作更不容易按偏。
body.en: On mobile, the public website now also covers readability and interaction details that are easy to overlook. Footer text meets AA contrast requirements, making foreground and background easier to distinguish, while images lazy-load only when needed. ⟦It is like making station information readable to everyone, lighting up platform displays only as you approach, and leaving enough room for the clickable areas of buttons and links.⟧ Every tap target measures at least 24px, with the primary mobile navigation reaching 44px to make finger input less error-prone.

items.original: **The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).

title.zh-TW: 官網主題總數校正為 13 款，補齊 Catppuccin 計數
title.en: Website theme count updated from 12 to 13 to include Catppuccin

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽官方網站的主題清單時，頁面上標示的主題總數已在全部五種語言版本中統一由 12 款修正為 13 款。先前在 0.29.23 版推出的 Catppuccin 主題配色一直未被計入網站的統計數字中，這次更新在所有語系頁面中如實補上了這項遺漏。⟦這像展示櫃明明陳列了 13 款特色商品，外頭目錄清單卻少算了一款，如今目錄將漏掉的款式如實補上，讓各語系型錄的標示與架上款式完全一致。⟧現在造訪官網不同語言版本，所見的主題統計都能正確反映當前完整的 13 種配色。
body.en: The theme counter across all five language versions of the public website has been updated from 12 to 13. The Catppuccin color scheme introduced in version 0.29.23 had been left out of the site's tally, causing the displayed figure to lag behind reality. ⟦This is like a showroom featuring 13 distinct models while the printed catalog mistakenly tallies 12 until an update fixes the count.⟧ Every localized version of the website now accurately showcases the full lineup of 13 themes.

items.original: **The website's theme count was corrected from 12 to 13** — Catppuccin, shipped in 0.29.23, wasn't being counted — across all five languages.

title.zh-TW: 社群預覽圖反映 Windows 支援，體積縮小更輕量
title.en: Social preview image reflects Windows support and shrinks in size

body.zh-TW: 在社群平台分享官方網站連結時，縮圖卡片（social preview image，社群預覽圖片）已全面翻新。過去圖片標題寫著「macOS Menu Bar App」，現在全新的 1200×630 圖片將品牌與標題結合網站原生配色的實際面板截圖（涵蓋 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity），清楚展現對 Windows 的支援。此外，圖片檔案大小也從原本的 573KB 大幅縮減至 96KB，讓分享預覽圖檔案更輕量。⟦像車站指示牌原本只標示 macOS，現加入 Windows、放上實際服務面板，並換成更輕薄的材質。⟧
body.en: Sharing website links on social platforms now generates an updated preview card that reflects Windows availability alongside macOS. The old image labeled the project strictly as a "macOS Menu Bar App", whereas the new 1200×630 visual pairs the brand and title with an authentic panel screenshot (featuring Claude, Codex, and Antigravity) rendered in the site's distinct color palette. File size dropped dramatically from 573KB down to 96KB, with the smaller preview file size. ⟦It is like a station sign that previously listed only macOS, now adding Windows and an authentic service-panel image on lighter material.⟧

items.original: **The social preview image reflects Windows support and reuses the site's own visuals.** It used to say "macOS Menu Bar App"; the new 1200×630 image pairs the brand and title with an actual panel screenshot (Claude, Codex, Antigravity) in the site's own colors, and dropped from 573KB to 96KB.

title.zh-TW: README 狀態列截圖升級為多語言動態展示
title.en: README status-line screenshots upgraded to localized animations

body.zh-TW: 查閱 README 說明文件時，狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機底部的即時資訊列）展示畫面已升級為動態錄製的動畫。過去非英文語系都是借用英文版的靜態截圖，現在每一種語言版本都配備了專屬的錄製動圖。⟦如同健身教室不再讓所有學員看同一張英文姿勢照片，而是依各語言播放專屬的動態示範。⟧所有動圖都針對 README 的版面寬度進行了最佳化調整，確保文字在各語言環境下都能清晰易讀。
body.en: Viewing the status-line previews in the README now presents fully recorded animations tailored to each language. Non-English translations previously borrowed static screenshots from the English README. ⟦It is like a fitness class no longer showing every learner the same English posture photo, but playing a dedicated moving demonstration for each language.⟧ Every supported language now features its own animated recording, scaled to stay sharp and legible within the standard README reading width.

items.original: **README status-line screenshots are now recorded animations**, one per language instead of borrowed from English, made legible at README width.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列設定升格為 README 獨立章節，補齊平台術語
title.en: Status-line setup becomes a dedicated README section with platform terms

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機配置狀態列的讀者，現在能在 README 中直接找到專屬的設定章節。過去這段教學作為子章節被埋在 Windows Support（Windows 支援）底下，導致 macOS 使用者容易直接錯過；現在它被獨立成頂層章節，並完整補齊了兩大平台與繁體中文的專業術語對照。⟦彷彿將熱門服務台從特定附錄搬到大廳正中央，並補齊多系統與繁體中文標籤，讓所有訪客一進門就能找到指引。⟧無論你在哪種作業系統上使用 usage，都能順暢依照母語術語完成狀態列設定。
body.en: Finding setup instructions for terminal status-lines in the README is now immediate and straightforward. The guide was formerly tucked away as a sub-topic under Windows Support, causing macOS users to overlook it entirely. It now commands its own dedicated section, complete with terminology aligned for both platforms and Traditional Chinese. ⟦As if moving a popular information desk from a remote corner annex to the main lobby so visitors on every path spot it right away.⟧ Users across operating systems can now easily locate relevant setup steps and terminology.

items.original: **Status-line setup is now its own README section** instead of a subsection buried under Windows Support, so macOS users don't skip it, with terminology filled in for both platforms and Traditional Chinese.

entries: **Cards trace a warning light around their border at 90%.** When a Session or weekly row crosses 90%, a red arc travels around that card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, on the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards alike. The Default panel carries it today; other panels are unchanged.
**Progress tracks now mark the 80% threshold.** A tick sits where the bar turns red, so how much headroom is left reads at a glance instead of only from the percentage text.

**The rate label now falls back after you stop working.** Burn rate divided by the span between the first and last usage entry, which left idle time out of the denominator — a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. It now divides by the time elapsed since the first entry, so the rate decays while you are away. Thresholds and the cache-read exclusion are unchanged.
**Numeric readouts line up.** Project token counts, costs, and percentages use tabular figures, so the columns stop shifting as the digits change.
**Keyboard focus is visible on the Default panel**, and its buttons now animate between hover states instead of snapping. Both respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

title.zh-TW: 超過九成亮起外框紅光，Default 面板警戒更直觀
title.en: Card borders trace warning lights at 90% in Default panel

body.zh-TW: Default 面板的卡片外框會亮起紅色動態警示，標出超過 90% 的工作階段（session，單次對話或任務的連續使用期間）或每週用量。⟦如同精密儀器在警戒線邊界亮起環形跑馬燈，紅光沿著邊緣繞行，提醒操作者留意殘量。⟧一條紅色弧線每 2.6 秒會繞著卡片邊緣跑動一圈，在 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity 卡片上皆有一致的視覺效果。目前這項警戒光效果由 Default 面板提供，其餘面板則維持不變。
body.en: The Default panel now traces a red active warning light around the border of any session or weekly row above 90%. ⟦It is like a precision instrument activating a perimeter warning beacon at critical capacity, running a red glow along the edge to alert the operator.⟧ A red arc travels around the card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, appearing consistently across Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards. The Default panel carries this warning light today, while other panels remain unchanged.

items.original: **Cards trace a warning light around their border at 90%.** When a Session or weekly row crosses 90%, a red arc travels around that card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, on the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards alike. The Default panel carries it today; other panels are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 進度條標出八成門檻刻度，剩餘額度一眼看清
title.en: Progress tracks mark the 80% threshold for at-a-glance headroom

body.zh-TW: 上限前還剩多少額度，現在能從進度條一眼看出。進度軌道在 80% 門檻處新增了刻度標記，位置正好落在進度條轉為紅色的交界點。這讓你能一眼看出達到上限前還剩下多少可用餘裕（headroom，額度耗盡前的剩餘緩衝空間），不必再依賴純文字數字進行推算。⟦這好比在透明量筒的八成高度標上一道分界刻度，液面一逼近紅線，不必細讀數字刻度也能立刻掌握剩餘容量。⟧
body.en: Remaining headroom is now visible at a glance instead of requiring you to read percentage text. Progress tracks now display a tick mark at the 80% threshold, positioned precisely where the bar turns red. This allows you to assess how much headroom (the buffer remaining before hitting limits) is left at a glance instead of reading raw percentage text. ⟦It is like marking a boundary line at the eighty percent level on a measuring cylinder, letting you gauge remaining capacity the moment fluid nears the line without inspecting numbers.⟧

items.original: **Progress tracks now mark the 80% threshold.** A tick sits where the bar turns red, so how much headroom is left reads at a glance instead of only from the percentage text.

title.zh-TW: 休息時消耗速率自動回落，計入閒置時間更貼近真實
title.en: Burn rate decays after stopping work as idle time enters the denominator

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 10 分鐘後休息 40 分鐘，消耗速率標籤會開始回落，不再一直釘在「Heavy」。過去計算速率時，只除以第一筆到最後一筆紀錄之間的間隔，分母漏掉了閒置時間；這導致密集使用 10 分鐘後休息 40 分鐘，標籤仍會被釘在「Heavy」狀態，直到滿 1 小時視窗過期。現在分母改以第一筆紀錄起算經過的總時間計算，離開時速率就會逐漸衰減。各級門檻與快取讀取（cache-read，讀取暫存資料）排除規則皆維持不變。⟦這如同計算長途旅行的平均時速，把停靠休息站的空檔也算入時間分母，車子熄火後儀表板均速便會自然往下降。⟧
body.en: A ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break no longer leaves the rate label pinned at "Heavy". Previously, burn rate was calculated by dividing only by the span between the first and last usage entry, excluding idle time from the denominator; a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. The rate now divides by the total time elapsed since the first entry, allowing it to decay while you are away. Threshold levels and the cache-read exclusion remain unchanged. ⟦It is like calculating trip speed by including time spent parked at a rest stop in the denominator, so average speed steadily drops while the engine is off.⟧

items.original: **The rate label now falls back after you stop working.** Burn rate divided by the span between the first and last usage entry, which left idle time out of the denominator — a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. It now divides by the time elapsed since the first entry, so the rate decays while you are away. Thresholds and the cache-read exclusion are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 專案讀數改用等寬數字，排版欄位不再左右晃動
title.en: Tabular figures align project readouts and stop column shifts

body.zh-TW: 數字跳動時，專案用量清單的欄位不再左右晃動或錯位了。⟦這有如機械翻牌式時刻表，每個數字格子寬度完全相同，任一欄位跳動都不會推擠到鄰近文字。⟧專案 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數、花費金額與百分比全面改用等寬數字，每個數字字元佔據相同寬度。當數值隨用量即時跳動時，縱向欄位不再左右晃動或錯位，版面閱讀體驗更加穩定。
body.en: As digits change, columns in project usage lists no longer shift side to side. ⟦It is like a mechanical flip-board schedule where every digit occupies an identical slot width, preventing changes in one column from shoving neighboring text.⟧ Project token (the unit for AI processing and billing) counts, costs, and percentages now use tabular figures with uniform widths. As digits change with live activity, columns stop shifting or jittering horizontally, creating a steady visual layout.

items.original: **Numeric readouts line up.** Project token counts, costs, and percentages use tabular figures, so the columns stop shifting as the digits change.

title.zh-TW: Default 面板看清鍵盤焦點，按鈕平滑過渡並遵循動態偏好
title.en: Default panel shows keyboard focus and animates hover states smoothly

body.zh-TW: Default 面板會清楚亮出鍵盤焦點（focus，鍵盤目前選中並可接收按鍵指令的介面位置）。面板上的按鈕在滑鼠懸停（hover）狀態之間，也改以平滑動畫過渡，不再生硬地瞬間切換。這兩項視覺改進都會自動遵循系統的「減少動態效果」設定，若使用者偏好靜態介面，系統會關閉動態過渡。⟦宛如舞台上的聚光燈與調光燈具，鍵盤移動時焦點清晰可辨，游標滑過時按鈕柔和漸變，遇到調暗需求時也能維持靜止。⟧
body.en: The Default panel now clearly shows keyboard focus (the interface element currently selected to receive keystrokes). Buttons on the panel also animate smoothly between hover states rather than snapping abruptly. Both visual improvements respect the system's reduced-motion setting, falling back to static states if the user prefers reduced motion. ⟦It is like stage spotlights paired with dimmer switches: the focus is immediately clear as you step through, buttons glow smoothly as the cursor passes, and transitions remain static whenever calm lighting is requested.⟧

items.original: **Keyboard focus is visible on the Default panel**, and its buttons now animate between hover states instead of snapping. Both respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

entries: **`usage status` prints your quota for other tools to read.** Until now the only way to get quota out of usage was to import its internals from Python. `usage status` gives a one-line summary, `usage status --json` gives a versioned JSON payload, and both read the same local files as the menu bar — no network call. The [development docs](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) include ready-made Starship and tmux snippets.

**Releases now ship build provenance and an SBOM.** Every macOS and Windows artifact carries a signed SLSA build-provenance attestation, verifiable with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage`, and the macOS release includes a CycloneDX software bill of materials listing every bundled dependency.

**The offline price table now says how old it is.** When the upstream price list can't be reached, usage falls back to a built-in table; that table now records the date it was last checked against upstream and logs a warning when it is used, so a silently outdated price can be spotted instead of quietly skewing your cost totals.

**Installing usage as a Python package no longer leaves modules behind.** The packaging allowlist covered 39 of the 74 top-level modules, so an installed copy crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError`. The list is complete now and a test keeps it that way.

title.zh-TW: 用指令快速查額度，終端機與狀態列隨調隨用
title.en: Check quota directly via CLI for external terminal tools

body.zh-TW: 想在 Starship 提示字元或 tmux 狀態列隨時盯著 AI 剩餘額度，過去就像非得請水電工拆開儀表箱才能讀取數據，必須寫 Python 程式硬挖 usage 的內部模組。現在正面直接裝上了液晶小螢幕：新指令 `usage status` 會直接印出一行摘要，加上 `--json` 參數還能輸出帶版號的 JSON 資料。兩者跟選單列讀取同一份本機檔案，完全不發送額外網路請求，看一眼就知道剩餘額度而不用聯網查詢；官方開發文件還附上了現成的設定範例，方便你直接貼進設定檔。
body.en: If you want your Starship prompt or tmux status bar to show remaining AI quota, you no longer need to write custom Python scripts importing usage's internal modules. The new `usage status` command prints a concise one-line summary, and `--json` outputs a versioned JSON payload. Both read the same local files as the menu bar item, requiring zero network calls. Ready-made snippets in the development documentation make setup immediate. It is like a utility meter on a house: instead of calling a technician to disassemble the mechanical counter inside, a digital readout on the front now lets any display read current consumption without contacting the utility company.

The [development docs](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) include ready-made Starship and tmux snippets.

title.zh-TW: 附帶組建來源證明與物料清單，安裝檔來源透明可驗證
title.en: Releases include build provenance and SBOM for verified security

body.zh-TW: 下載安裝檔時，現在你可以確切核實檔案是否真的由官方原始碼編譯而成。每個 macOS 與 Windows 發行檔案現在都附帶經過數位簽署的 SLSA 組建來源證明，只要執行 `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage` 指令就能核對檔案產銷履歷；macOS 版本還額外附上 CycloneDX 格式的軟體物料清單（SBOM，詳細列出所有內建相依套件的名冊）。這種透明度好比購買進口食品，包裝上貼有可掃描產銷履歷的防偽溯源標籤以證明未遭調包，背面更印有完整成分配料表，讓每項零件與函式庫的來源都一清二楚。
body.en: When downloading release artifacts, you can now mathematically verify that your binaries were built directly from official source code. Every macOS and Windows release artifact now ships with a signed SLSA build-provenance attestation, verifiable in your terminal using the `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage` command. In addition, the macOS release includes a CycloneDX software bill of materials (SBOM) detailing every bundled dependency. It is like buying packaged organic food: the box carries a certified supply-chain tracking seal proving the product was never swapped in transit, alongside a complete ingredient list that reveals every sub-component inside.

title.zh-TW: 離線價目表標註查核日期，啟用備援時主動發出警示
title.en: Offline price table tracks its check date and warns on fallback

body.zh-TW: 網路斷線或無法連上最新價目表時，計算模型花費不再容易被過期費率誤導。當 usage 無法抓取線上最新價格時，會自動切換為內建的離線價目表作為備援；這份內建表格現在記錄了上次與官方核對的日期，並在啟用時主動於日誌留下警告訊息，讓你能一眼看出目前使用的是舊資料，而不是悄悄算錯累積費用。這好比銀行櫃檯的電子匯率看板斷線時，行員改拿出抽屜裡的紙本費率表，以前紙上沒寫列印日期容易算錯，現在紙面蓋有「最後核對日期」的大章並在單據記下備用註記，避免帳目在不知不覺中出現落差。
body.en: When your network is down or upstream price lists cannot be reached, model cost calculations will no longer silently drift on outdated rates. When usage cannot fetch live pricing, it falls back to a built-in pricing table. That built-in table now records the exact date it was last synced against upstream and writes a warning to the log whenever it is engaged, making stale pricing immediately visible before it skews your cost totals. It is like an exchange counter whose electronic rate board goes dark: the teller pulls a printed rate sheet from the drawer, but the sheet now displays an inspection date stamp and a written notation is logged on the slip, ensuring no one calculates totals under the mistaken impression that prices are current.

items.original: **The offline price table now says how old it is.** When the upstream price list can't be reached, usage falls back to a built-in table; that table now records the date it was last checked against upstream and logs a warning when it is used, so a silently outdated price can be spotted instead of quietly skewing your cost totals.

title.zh-TW: Python 套件補齊所有模組，安裝不再因缺檔而報錯崩潰
title.en: Python package includes all modules to stop ModuleNotFoundError crashes

body.zh-TW: 透過 Python 套件管理工具安裝 usage，過去就像買到了裝箱清單只勾了一半零件的組裝家具材料包。先前打包設定的模組白名單只收錄了 74 個頂層模組中的 39 個，害使用者安裝後執行時，常因找不到其餘模組而跳出 `ModuleNotFoundError` 錯誤當機；現在打包清單已完整補齊全部 74 個模組，並新增了自動化測試來防止未來漏掉檔案。這如同材料包出廠清單已補齊所有配件，且出廠前一律經過自動掃描確認，買回家不再組裝到一半才發現缺了螺絲與木板。
body.en: Developers who install usage as a Python package will no longer hit instant crashes caused by missing files. Previously, the packaging allowlist included only 39 of the 74 top-level modules, causing installed copies to crash immediately with a `ModuleNotFoundError`. The packaging list now includes all 74 modules, and an automated regression test ensures no files are forgotten in future releases. It is like buying a boxed furniture kit whose packing checklist only listed half the necessary parts, leaving customers stranded mid-assembly without key screws or panels; the factory checklist now includes every single component, with a scanner verifying each box before shipment.

items.original: **Installing usage as a Python package no longer leaves modules behind.** The packaging allowlist covered 39 of the 74 top-level modules, so an installed copy crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError`. The list is complete now and a test keeps it that way.
